##### Project general facts

AYAT Parkview by AYAT Development is a residential building that brings calm, considered living to a green, well-connected neighbourhood. Contemporary architecture combines clean facade lines, spacious balconies, a refined neutral palette and geometric forms to create an elegant urban character. The building rises from a ground floor to nine residential floors and a roof, offering one- and two-bedroom apartments, with selected layouts including an additional room suitable for a study or guest room.

Residents enjoy a rooftop swimming pool with a dedicated children's pool, separate fitness centres for men and women and a serene yoga area for a balanced routine. A multipurpose hall, a children's play area and a landscaped rooftop garden create welcoming spaces for relaxation, family time and social gatherings, while round-the-clock security and lifts add everyday comfort and peace of mind for residents and their guests throughout the year.

Interiors are defined by simplicity, serenity and quality craftsmanship, with clean lines, soft neutral palettes and light-filled spaces. Natural stone and warm wood accents bring a sense of understated elegance, while thoughtful layouts balance practicality with a genuine sense of ease. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Liwan is a residential neighbourhood in Dubailand, set within Wadi Al Safa and known for its mid-rise apartment buildings, landscaped streets and calm atmosphere. Community retail, supermarkets, cafes and clinics serve residents nearby, while Dubai Silicon Oasis and the green communities of Dubailand are close by, making the area popular with families and young professionals.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Ain Road connect residents with the wider city. Dubai Silicon Oasis, Dubai Outlet Mall and Global Village are a short drive away, Dubai Academic City and IMG Worlds of Adventure are close by, and Downtown Dubai, Business Bay and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable driving distance for work and travel.

Liwan is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the more accessible entry points to the Dubai property market. Homes with rooftop amenities and separate fitness facilities appeal to families and young professionals seeking value. Competitive prices, a calm residential setting and strong road links underpin steady rental demand and long-term value for owners and investors.
